description: Unit tests for the Basket entity in the application core, focusing on adding items, incrementing quantities, handling default and invalid quantities.

classes.name: BasketAddItem
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the Basket entity's AddItem functionality, verifying correctness and exception handling.

methods.name: AddsBasketItemIfNotPresent
methods.description: Tests adding a new item to the basket when it is not already present.

methods.name: IncrementsQuantityOfItemIfPresent
methods.description: Tests that adding the same item increments its quantity.

methods.name: KeepsOriginalUnitPriceIfMoreItemsAdded
methods.description: Ensures the unit price remains unchanged when additional items are added with a different unit price.

methods.name: DefaultsToQuantityOfOne
methods.description: Confirms that adding an item without specifying quantity defaults to 1.

methods.name: CantAddItemWithNegativeQuantity
methods.description: Validates that adding an item with negative quantity throws an ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

methods.name: CantModifyQuantityToNegativeNumber
methods.description: Checks that increasing an existing item's quantity to a negative value throws an exception.
